title: X Feed Digest
summary: Agentic tooling keeps accelerating: Anthropic bought Vercept.ai to push Claude’s computer-use stack, Vercel shipped an agent-browser CLI, and OpenFang open-sourced a security-first agent OS.
Claude’s ecosystem saw meaningful upgrades—Cowork added scheduled tasks and Claude Code 2.1.59 introduced persistent memory rules plus a model change.
Model chatter continues with reports of DeepSeek V4 Lite testing a 1M-token, multimodal variant.
Markets focus on AI-driven momentum: Nvidia posted blowout Q4 growth, while Coinbase expands into stock/ETF trading and investors debate SDGR’s AI drug-discovery upside.
Notable science/health: Perseverance now self-localizes on Mars in minutes, and a small iScience study highlights a simple seated calf exercise for glucose control.

items.title: @AnthropicAI: Acquires Vercept.ai
items.body: Anthropic announced it acquired Vercept.ai to accelerate Claude’s computer-use capabilities, signaling a bigger push into agents that can operate real GUIs and workflows.

items.title: @claudeai: Cowork Scheduled Tasks
items.body: Claude Cowork now supports scheduled tasks, letting teams run recurring automations (daily briefs, weekly spreadsheet updates, Friday decks) on a timer instead of manual prompts.

items.title: @_vmlops: Vercel Agent-Browser CLI
items.body: Vercel released agent-browser, a CLI that lets AI agents navigate sites, click/type, persist sessions, and run full workflows—making browser automation a first-class agent tool.

items.title: @ClaudeCodeLog: Claude Code 2.1.59
items.body: Claude Code 2.1.59 adds auto memory rules for cross-session persistence, switches the underlying model, and tightens approvals for session IDs and tool access.

items.title: @Akashi203: OpenFang Agent OS
items.body: OpenFang open-sourced a Rust-based “agent OS” with WASM sandboxes, multi-layer security, and scheduled “Hands” that run continuously without babysitting.

items.title: @legit_api: DeepSeek V4 Lite Rumor
items.body: Reports claim DeepSeek V4 Lite is in testing with at least one inference provider, featuring a 1M-token context window and native multimodality—still unconfirmed but notable.

items.title: @jasonboshi: AI Learning Study
items.body: A randomized study on developers found AI-assisted learners scored 17% lower on skill mastery on average, but outcomes varied—conceptual questioning preserved learning while copy‑paste use degraded it.

items.title: @KKaWSB: Nvidia Q4 FY2026
items.body: Nvidia’s FY2026 Q4 results showed 73% revenue growth and 65% margins, with data center up 75% and EPS nearly doubling—reinforcing the AI demand thesis.

items.title: @LunarCrush: Coinbase Stock/ETF Trading
items.body: Coinbase launched stock and ETF trading to compete more directly with Robinhood, signaling a push beyond crypto into full-service retail brokerage.

items.title: @AviatoResearch: SDGR Thesis
items.body: A thread argues Schrodinger ($SDGR) looks undervalued if AI-driven drug discovery re-rates, citing its physics+AI platform, pharma software revenue, and upcoming catalysts.

items.title: @KKaWSB: Perseverance Self-Navigation
items.body: NASA says Perseverance can now self-localize on Mars using the retired Ingenuity helicopter processor, cutting localization time from a day to ~2 minutes with ~25 cm accuracy.

items.title: @iPaulCanada: Soleus Push-Up Study
items.body: A small iScience study reports that seated soleus push-ups after a glucose drink improved blood-sugar metabolism; the takeaway is a simple, low-effort post‑meal movement (still early evidence).
